sloka: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम ।कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि ।। ५.६८.३ ।।।।
transliteration: yadi vā manyase vīra vasaikāhamarindama ।kasmiṁścitsaṁvṛte deśe viśrāntaḥ śvo gamiṣyasi ।। 5.68.3 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O crusher of enemies O brave Hanuman I wish you rest for a while in a secluded place around here and leave tomorrow .
